card.line: Helam was a place east of the Jordan where the Arameans gathered for battle and where David defeated them, which ended their help to the Ammonites.

moments.title: Arameans gather at Helam
moments.text: Hadadezer sent for more Arameans from beyond the Euphrates. They came to Helam with Shobach, the commander of his army, leading them.

moments.title: David fights at Helam
moments.text: When David heard the news, he gathered all Israel and crossed the Jordan to Helam. The Arameans lined up against him and fought. They fled, and Shobach their commander died there. The kings under Hadadezer then made peace with Israel.
